First Visit

What happens first.

Here is how your first day runs from the front door to your first coached round.

1

You check in.

Arrive 15 minutes early. We greet you at the door, give you the room tour, and introduce you to your coach.

2

Safety gets explained.

We cover tapping, pacing, boundaries, and Beginner Lane before you step onto the mat.

3

You start calmly.

Sandy guides your first class at your pace. Adults can choose live partner practice. You can pause or end a round.

4

You can adjust by text.

If timing changes because of weather, work, or family, text Sandy and easily reschedule anytime.
